description: HTTP Digest Authentication for Ky. Built for CCTV, NVR, and other embedded devices.
rules: Do not disable Ky retries completely (retry.limit: 0) — Digest Authentication requires at least one retry to complete after the 401 challenge.
Use HTTPS whenever the target server supports it; Digest Authentication does not encrypt HTTP traffic.
Do not embed shared service credentials in publicly distributed browser code; use a trusted backend for fixed or privileged credentials.
The first request still requires a server challenge even when preemptive is enabled.
